note: An append-only log of issuers and lists, and of attestations by salted hash. It never holds a person, a presentation or a record's content. Its checkpoints' times are the log's own claims; a public witness over each checkpoint's payload hash is what makes a time stand. Anyone may mirror these files and rebuild the tree from entries/ alone. Without gossip between mirrors, a checker shown one view cannot see a split view it was not shown.
